snapshot.title: Ohio EPA DDAGW: Advisory Remains in Effect

fields.orgName: Ohio Environmental Protection Agency - Division of Drinking and Ground Waters

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: This is the Ohio EPA DDAGW Liaison. We have received your emergency report. The Carver County Health Commissioner confirms that the Boil Water Advisory for Zone 2 remains in effect due to confirmed loss of disinfection and pressure below 20 psi.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The emergency contact (555-037-9000) has been updated. You must maintain the advisory until two full 24-hour sampling cycles are completed and verified.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: The Ohio EPA will not lift the advisory without written confirmation from the City Manager and the Water Quality Manager. You are authorized to close the incident only when all criteria in Section 4.4 Level 3 are met and the control system is restored under the OT Plan return-to-service checklist.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: We expect your final report by 10:00.

snapshot.instructorNote: This is a final authority confirmation. The Incident Commander must confirm that the advisory will remain active until two full 24-hour sampling cycles are complete and the final report is submitted by 10:00. The system remains in emergency state.
